en.headline: Police arrest 53 in Double Hammer operation targeting triad drug and vice activities
en.dek: Officers seized about 3.6 kg of cannabis products worth nearly HK$1 million and raided a public-housing packaging centre and a Wan Chai private club.
body: Hong Kong Island Regional Crime Unit, working with the Immigration Department, arrested 53 people in an operation code-named Double Hammer against triad-linked drug trafficking, prostitution and gambling.
Those held comprised 25 men and 28 women aged 19 to 68, including 22 local residents, 19 mainland Chinese and 12 foreign nationals. Police said 11 were key members of the groups.

Officers found a cannabis storage and packaging centre in a Chai Wan public housing flat and seized 3.6 kg of cannabis flower and related products valued at about HK$1 million. They also raided a Wan Chai private club suspected of operating as a vice venue and arrested 4 men and 13 women there. Investigations continue.

zh.headline: 警方「雙錘」行動打擊三合會黃賭毒 拘捕53人檢獲3600克大麻
zh.dek: 港島總區聯同入境處行動，包括柴灣公屋毒品包裝中心及灣仔私人會所，檢獲市值約100萬元毒品。
body: 港島總區刑事部聯同入境處展開代號「雙錘」反三合會行動，打擊涉及兩個三合會的販毒、賣淫及賭博活動，共拘捕53人。
被捕者包括25男28女，年齡19至68歲，當中22名本地人、19名內地人及12名外籍人士，警方指有11人為骨幹成員。
人員在柴灣一公屋單位搜獲3600克大麻花及相關產品，市值約100萬元；亦在灣仔一私人會所拘捕4男13女。調查仍在進行。
